# If the metric can be improved by making the cont

## The heuristic

**If the metric can be improved by making the contact button harder to find, it is not measuring what you think it is measuring.**


_Why:_ Any instrument that infers success from the absence of a ticket rewards obstruction and answering identically, and obstruction is cheaper. Success has to be claimed by the customer, not inferred from their silence.
